full_query: do chlamdia often cure itself or does it cause permanent damage
sentences: Chlamydia trachomatis infections often do not resolve on their own and can cause permanent damage if left untreated
While some bacterial infections may occasionally resolve without treatment, this is not typical for chlamydia
Most women with genital tract chlamydial infections are asymptomatic, which makes it more challenging to diagnose and treat promptly
Untreated chlamydia can lead to severe reproductive complications, such as pelvic inflammatory disease, tubal factor infertility, and ectopic pregnancy
The pathogen has evolved mechanisms to evade the host immune system and persist within host epithelial cells, thus making spontaneous resolution unlikely
